article.title: Why the rushed Postal Service plan for mail-in voting has states in a panic
article.author: Editor
article.content: President Donald Trump’s executive order placing new restrictions on mail-in voting would assign state officials a Herculean task to reach compliance before the crucial midterm elections. The post Why the rushed Postal Service plan for mail-in voting has states in a panic appeared first on MR Online .
